jobs.description:
Job Title: Product Management Intern (Durable Goods)

Job Details

Division: Nucor Insulated Panel Group LLC

Location: Lewisville, TX, United States

Other Available Locations: N/A
Basic Job Functions:

We are seeking an enthusiastic Product Management intern for our Product Innovation team to support new and continued product development of commercial construction products. You will have duties across various business activities to help drive the development, launch, and management of products to maximize portfolio profitability.

As a Product Management intern, you will collaborate with teammates within, but not limited to, product development, research and testing, training, project management, and marketing disciplines. Your insightful contribution will help develop and expand our product portfolio growth.

This internship will help you acquire various cross-functional skills and provide you with broad experience in product lifecycle management. Ultimately, you will be better prepared to support a product portfolio in an environment that promotes innovation.

Safety is the most important part of all jobs within Nucor; therefore, candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practices, procedures, and housekeeping standards at all times.

Responsibilities

- Support product-focused market research, competitive analysis, and customer feedback collection

- Gather and organize internal and external supporting information for business cases

- Assist Product Managers and marketing teams with product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market planning

- Support the product development process through various stages with necessary information, administrative tasks, and process implementation

- Work with Product Managers and cross-functional teams to develop product documentation

- Research and summarize relevant trends, technologies, and regulations within the commercial construction industry

Minimum Qualifications:

- Strong desire to learn about product management, supported by initiative, curiosity, and professional drive

- Strong analytical, research, organizational, and problem-solving skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teammates

- Excellent knowledge of MS Office

- Ability to collect, organize, and interpret quantitative and qualitative information

- Current enrollment in a related bachelor’s or master’s degree program (marketing, business, finance, engineering, construction management, or a related field)

Nucor is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – M/F/Disabled/Vets – and a drug – free workplace

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner-Full Stack
jobs.description:
Job Details

Division: Nucor Buildings Group

Location: Nashville metropolitan area, TN United States

Nucor Buildings Group (NBG) is seeking a Product Owner to help turn business opportunities and innovative ideas into valuable digital products for its NBG’s Product Innovation Group. This unique role combines product ownership with hands-on full-stack engineering , providing a strong technical connection between users, product priorities, and the development team. The successful candidate will help define what we build and why , manage and prioritize product needs, translate them into actionable development work, and contribute directly to building and delivering solutions using our modern Python, .NET, React, and Azure technology stack.

Basic Job Functions:

- Own and prioritize the product backlog , translating stakeholder needs and opportunities into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

- Partner with users and stakeholders to define what should be built, why it matters, and how success will be measured .

- Contribute hands-on to full-stack development using Python, React/TypeScript, C#/.NET, APIs, SQL, and Azure .

- Collaborate with the development team to balance product priorities, technical considerations, delivery effort, and iterative releases.

- Use feedback, application insights, and emerging technologies, including AI, to continuously improve product capabilities and user value.

Safety is the most important part of all jobs within Nucor; therefore, candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practices, procedures, and housekeeping standards at all times.

Minimum Qualifications:

- 5+ years of experience in software development, technical product ownership, or a combination of both.

- Strong experience with Python, React, TypeScript, C#, .NET/ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, and SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL.

- Experience working with stakeholders to understand needs and translate them into priorities, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

- Experience with product prioritization, backlog management, demonstrations, and feedback cycles.

- Experience with automated Playwright testing, Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and cloud application development.

- Ability to balance product priorities, technical considerations, and delivery needs.

- Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.

-  Legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship now or in the future.

- Due to the specific projects supported by this team, only United States Citizens or permanent residents are eligible to apply.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, or similar role while remaining technically hands-on.

- Experience taking products from concept/POC through production and continuous improvement.

- Experience developing commercial or enterprise applications.

- Experience with Azure, Docker, CI/CD, security, and observability.

- Experience with product analytics and user feedback.

- Experience with Azure AI Foundry, RAG, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and/or MCP.

Why Nucor:

Welcome to Nucor, where our unique culture sets us apart. Joining Nucor means becoming part of North America's largest steel and steel products manufacturer, offering unmatched career opportunities and stability. We are known for our innovative sustainability practices and are the continent's largest recycler. Our vibrant culture, built on personal connections and teamwork, empowers every team member with the freedom to innovate and contribute to our collective success. Experience a workplace where safety, efficiency, and meaningful personal connections define every day, enriching both our teammates and the communities we serve.

Nucor supports its teammates with top-tier benefits like Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability Insurance, 401K and Roth accounts, Profit sharing, Pay-for-performance bonuses, Paid parental leave, Tuition reimbursement, Stock program, Scholarships and more.

Nucor is an EEO/AAP Employer – M/F/Disabled/Vet and Drug Free Workplace
